newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tateho Chemical shares suspended from trade--Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Tateho Chemical shares suspended from trade--Jiji.

text.p: Trade in shares of Tateho Chemical Industries Co Ltd was suspended on the Osaka bourse on Friday, Jiji news agency reported.

The news agency said the shares were suspended from trade due to unclear information concerning a report of a possible merger with Daido Hoxan Inc. The report appeared in financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun on Friday.

The paper said Daido Hoxan is in talks with Sakura Bank Ltd, through which Tateho Chemical does most of its financial transactions, concerning the elimination of some of Tateho Chemical's debts before it takes over the firm.
A spokesman for Daido Hoxan was not immediately available for comment on the report.
